fields.statement: Built ./cmd/rhiza at 5dd508d and ran rhiza run start --workflow review --permission-mode manual inside a real Rex block (rex run --wait). It ran on a scratch repo with a built two-leaf change set: a fake claude played the agents and a fake rex opened their tabs. Real Rex got the OSC 7501 reports, read back with rex events --json. Quality's cycle 1 had two confirmed majors, f1 on leaf alpha and f2 on the change set. Rex showed, in order: leaf/1 working 'alpha: fixer working (attempt 2)', a clear of leaf/1, leaf/1 'alpha: verifier working (attempt 2)', then fix 'review: fixer working (attempt 2)', and clears of leaf/1 and fix. The root record stayed 'step review · 4 of 5 checks passed' throughout. Quality cycle 2 then passed, and the run stopped at signoff.

Built ./cmd/rhiza at 5dd508d and ran the builtin review inside a real Rex block on a scratch repo whose leaf beta had no independent Evidence. Real Rex got, read back with rex events --json, the root record working 'step code', then error 'run failed: step "code" ended with outcome "fail"'. The run exited 1, and rhiza run status listed 'step code: fail (leaf beta: no Evidence verifies it)'.

Built ./cmd/rhiza at 5dd508d and ran the builtin review inside a real Rex block on a scratch repo where a fake quality check confirmed a major on leaf alpha in every cycle. Rex showed alpha's fixer and verifier at attempts 2 and 3, and quality at cycles 2 and 3. Then the root record was blocked: 'Review me: step review waits on you: Review check quality still fails after 3 cycles: finding f1 (major at alpha.txt:1) on leaf alpha: still too short. ...'. That message names the change set, the review step and the question's text. rhiza run status agreed: an unanswered question after cycle 3 on f1, blocking leaf alpha.
